reasons.persona_fit: The calm tone and audience match Bareni, but leaking prompt meta-language ('In the persona scenario') and reciting operational policy items mid-post weakens natural founder voice.
reasons.clarity: The core argument regarding open-ended retainers versus bounded workflows is clear and well-structured, though paragraph four reads like a policy checklist.
reasons.actionability: Gives a concrete, feasible next step for the owner to scope a single recurring workflow before committing further, with no unauthorized sales CTA.
reasons.factual_grounding: All statements adhere strictly to the approved evidence without exaggerating capabilities, inventing results, or violating approval boundaries.
